hardening.change: parseHandle now validates and reconstructs ref from identity-only fields via validateAndReconstructRef(). MalformedHandleError thrown for any ref with payload keys (data/fields/payload/view/snapshot), unknown keys, or unknown kind. Honest round-trip (AC-7) unaffected.
hardening.new_test_block: FF-9 (R-1 hardening): fail-closed parseHandle ref validation

hardening_r2_r3.change: parseHandle generalised to route through makeHandle after independent ref+facet validation. R-2 (facet payload bypass) closed via validateAndReconstructFacet() — any extra key, non-array fields, or non-string element in facet.fields throws MalformedHandleError. R-3 (cross-tenant on parse path) closed by passing validatedRef+tenantId into makeHandle which enforces the same cross-tenant binding as construction; parseHandle can no longer produce a handle that makeHandle would refuse. Wire handleId tamper detection: derived handleId compared against wire value after makeHandle; mismatch throws MalformedHandleError.
new_test_blocks: FF-9-R2: parseHandle rejects facet payload (R-2 hardening)
FF-9-R3: parseHandle rejects cross-tenant ref (R-3 hardening)
FF-9-AC7: honest round-trip (AC-7) — all 3 ref kinds × ±facet
